subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw accept raw `[[...]]` button JSON in final model text as a supported Gemini fallback, or require typed `message(action=send)` presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source confirms the gap, but accepting a parser would create a new model-output fallback syntax across final replies, transcripts, and Telegram presentation rendering.

options.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow a constrained parser after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

options.title: Retarget To Typed Routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the fix focused on prompting/provider behavior so Gemini emits structured message-tool buttons.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Leave the issue open without implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini-to-Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a constrained parser after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses the typed presentation contract, message-tool prompt guidance, and Telegram button rendering paths where recent history points most strongly.
